claims.statement: Both production targets use the shared main-actor ProAccessController, whose live purchase service is RevenueCat configured from the bundled API key and entitlement ID; invalid configuration has no StoreKit fallback and results in verification failure.

The local StoreKit fixture defines a family-shareable lifetime non-consumable and a family-shareable yearly auto-renewable subscription with a two-week free introductory offer, localized for English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese.

Only the configured RevenueCat entitlement grants Pro after successful verification; active nonexpiring entitlements map to lifetime access, while subscription access requires an unexpired active trial, subscription or billing-issue grace period and refunds, billing retry and expiration deny access.

RevenueCat customer-info stream updates supersede older controller refreshes, concurrent refreshes share one request, and a failed refresh retains already established access but an initial failure becomes verificationFailed; the service uses a current fetch and falls back to cached CustomerInfo on fetch failure.

ProFeature enumerates Vault sync, unlimited Hosts, Tailscale, SFTP multi-connection acceleration and port-forwarding multi-connection acceleration; require returns false and presents the shared paywall when access is absent without retaining a requested feature.

Free access unlocks three ordinary saved Hosts deterministically by creation date, undated legacy first, and UUID ties; locks are locally derived, deletion promotes the next Host, and distinct additions count toward quota while existing records remain editable. Tailscale is excluded and separately gated. Loading and failed verification hide locks but reject excess operations with distinct errors; initial resolution is awaited only when needed and rechecked before mutation, and quota checks precede identity/import side effects. Target and jump-host admission use a current-policy snapshot even in prepared/cached configurations; SSH, Agent, forwarding and new SFTP operations recheck access without cancelling already delegated SFTP transfers. Assistant, remote MCP and built-in MCP are not independent Pro features, but their Host operations obey admission. Uploads require session readiness rather than a separate Pro gate.

Both apps present RevenueCatUI PaywallView in native sheets, route purchase/restore callbacks through controller processing and refresh, and retain account paywall after purchase; macOS elects one main-window owner through ProPaywallPresenter.

AppReviewController owns device-local first use and shared response state, requiring seven elapsed days and a host with no response, not legacy budgets. Hosts and Vault snapshot eligibility on entry and hide while filtering or hostless. Decline or accepted review URL opening persists a response across windows and launches, never a completed rating; rejection consumes nothing. Preview bypasses eligibility except filtering, changes only transient previewResponse and never opens URLs or writes defaults. XCTest disables live invitations; mobile tests cover injection and English/Chinese renders. Shared AppReviewLink delegates to SwiftUI environment openURL rather than automatic StoreKit prompting.

Shared AppStrings and Localizable.xcstrings own native app copy and InfoPlist.xcstrings owns metadata. AGENTS requires manual normalization and finished zh-Hans/zh-Hant for changed English copy; check-localization.py enforces finished zh-Hans, zh-Hant, ja, ko, de and fr and normalization for both catalogs, with CI localization and normalization tests. AGENTS names the Python checker but its jq prerequisite is stale; generic jq formatting is explicitly prohibited.

The iOS extension contains only a workspace Live Activity. Credential/output-free snapshots retain at most six focused-first summaries, optional versioned recovery and opaque remote-session references, truncating titles and dropping whole entries to fit 3,500 bytes. Strict UUID recovery links carry only version/host/kind, accepting ssh, mosh, eternalTerminal, sftp and telnet but never remote-session references. Serialized updates restore one active/stale activity, end duplicates, retain disconnected recovery and suppress explicitly removed recovery; new activity creation requires explicit start intent. Missing workspaces deduplicate rebuilds and require a usable host/protocol and session selection, but stale recovery cannot recreate resumable Mosh/Eternal Terminal sessions.
DEBUG ScreenshotDemoConfiguration binds a validated scene to en, zh-Hans, zh-Hant, ja, ko, de or fr; the screenshot helper builds TFM and launches matching application language and locale overrides.

The parent repository identifies com.akinokaede.termind as an independent public website/assets submodule with an Astro project at its root, documents initialization only for website or asset work and an npm build workflow, and states that native builds do not require it; those parent-repository instructions do not verify the submodule's current implementation or deployed content.

For a granting subscription with a future known deadline the controller cancels its previous expiration timer and schedules a refresh at that deadline, while both app targets also refresh access on activation; the timer does not directly revoke access.

Production uses live RevenueCat access while in-memory/test/demo construction can use unrestricted access. App-owned accessDidChange callbacks update Host policy, Tailscale, Metrics and acceleration preferences without a visible paywall; desktop reconciles sync directly and mobile sync observation additionally requires an active scene, rather than suspending MCP on Pro loss.

AppLanguageTests covers preference migration, regional lookup, selected-language notices, reordered interpolation, contextual Memory/memory and token terminology, Korean provider labels, key association terminology, metadata and plurals across current languages, not explicit-language Pro offers; whole-catalog non-English completion is enforced by check-localization.py.

On iOS, Vault and Vault search open Snippets and Known Hosts with optional initial queries; Known Hosts distinguishes empty library from empty search results, offers add from the toolbar and edit/copy-fingerprint/delete per card, and selects add versus edit editor title based on whether the entry already exists.

On macOS, the Known Hosts empty state offers import or manual add; deletion has singular/plural localized confirmation text and warns that deleting trust means verifying the server key on the next connection, while editor labels distinguish adding and editing.

Mobile Snippets distinguishes empty library from no matches, supports new snippets/packages/subpackages, and package deletion offers retaining or removing snippets with count-sensitive shared wording and locale-formatted section counts.

Known-host and shared Snippet card timestamps use the view locale, while record titles, paths and scripts remain direct content. Both apps use SnippetCardContent for colored icon, eligible-target count, risk and timestamp; SnippetTimestamp preserves a local fallback for legacy baseline dates.

Mobile card tests cover editor titles, two-tag bounds, SSH/SFTP history timestamps and optional real-window multilingual captures; AppLanguageTests covers selected resources rather than Pro offers and the Python checker enforces six-language catalog coverage. mobile.compactCards persists reduced Hosts/Known Hosts/Snippets content without changing actions: standard hosts show address, tags and localized last connection or Never, compact hosts title/icon/status; standard Known Hosts includes algorithm/time, compact title/icon.

AppStrings groups shared semantic resources created on demand for catalogs compiled into each app's main bundle, including platform-specific variants; identifiers and diagnostic codes stay with their owners. Repository guidance keeps STRING_CATALOG_GENERATE_SYMBOLS = NO to avoid competing generated symbols.

App-facing resource text is resolved at presentation time from the main app bundle using the requested locale, while the SwiftUI key bridge preserves resource metadata and shared formatting composes localized counts/messages without translating user-authored values or caching language-specific strings.

The SwiftSyntax AppStrings checker scans TFM and TFI for selected UI literals and verifies the shared Strings/AppStrings owner file exists, while ArchitectureBoundaryTests guards the AppStrings owner and dependencies; these static checks complement the Chinese catalog check and runtime localization tests rather than proving all copy is reusable or properly rendered.

Manual normalization preserves stale keys and translations. The checker exempts shouldTranslate:false, otherwise requires finished units and preserves format argument positions, types and multiplicity including literal percent using English values where present. Chinese, Japanese and Korean plurals require other only, German one/other and French one/other with optional many; Japanese and Chinese spacing checks retain a narrow Type %@ exception and do not apply to Korean or European typography.

AppLanguage supports system plus canonical de, en, fr, ja, ko, zh-Hans and zh-Hant, with system first and explicit tags sorted. Explicit choices persist AppleLanguages and Follow System removes it. Only legacy Hans Chinese preferences migrate; unsupported stored tags follow system without rewriting. Catalog lookup resolves Chinese script and regional English/German/French/Japanese/Korean codes with main-bundle fallback; the Taiwan-specific Traditional Chinese label requires TW and flag availability.
Pro-dependent sync reconciliation starts or pauses Vault, connection-history, device, Metrics, and Settings coordinators on both platforms; mobile additionally requires an active foreground scene.

Mobile Metrics has no independent three-card entitlement cap: picker replacement delegates to the shared model and reports storage failures without an unlimited-Metrics paywall. Monitoring follows Host admission; a locked Host yields locked monitoring state and activating its mobile card presents Pro instead of detail.

LocalizedStringResource should be passed directly to supported SwiftUI title APIs rather than bridged through swiftUIKey. Mobile operationConfirmation explicitly resolves its text with the environment locale, then uses verbatim SwiftUI confirmation for anchored actions or an injected UIKit renderer for centered actions, retaining visible Cancel.

Shared Metrics selection replacement preserves selections outside the edited picker, deduplicates new additions, validates SSH availability and persists the replacement in one operation; there is no longer an independent entitlement-based Metrics card limit.

The catalog normalizer defaults to the two shared app catalogs, marks entries manual without deleting stale translations, rejects duplicate JSON keys before any batch write, and checks or writes Xcode-compatible serialization; AgentKit's separately owned runtime catalog requires its own localization build step.

RevenueCatProPurchaseService uses anonymous app user IDs rather than a device or iCloud account ID, configures StoreKit 2 with informational entitlement verification and disabled automatic device identifier collection, and supplies the stored language as preferred RevenueCat UI locale.

For a non-test-store user without Pro, RevenueCatProPurchaseService attempts to import pre-integration purchases via syncPurchases at most once per successful anonymous user ID migration and skips migration on verification failure.

Both native paywalls send ProPaywallState protocol variables for access, subscription management, family ownership, status and localized expiration to the remote dashboard; only purchaser-owned subscriptions expose the management variable and missing dates are not invented.

RevenueCatCommerceTests exercises configured entitlement resolution, grace deadlines, refund and verification failures, remote paywall completion, streamed updates, concurrent and racing refreshes, unavailable service and fetch failure recovery, rather than testing the remote paywall design or real purchases.

Current native paywall surfaces display a localized loading state and an unavailable fallback without a RevenueCat service, but leave the offer layout, trial terms and legal links to RevenueCatUI rather than constructing them from local paywall presentation types.
The local StoreKit fixture defines lifetime and annual products but does not prove production RevenueCat offering availability, purchase or trial eligibility.

AppLanguage supports canonical ja and AppLocalization resolves ja/ja-JP/ja_JP Japanese resources, tested with reordered interpolation and plurals. Desktop captures its language at app initialization and injects that locale into scenes; Settings persists a new selection without automatically relaunching and renders the relaunch notice explicitly in the selected language when different from the Settings view's captured launchLanguage.
